title: Local left inverse of an immersion, differentiable at the image point (inverse function theorem)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ and x₀ ∈ ℝⁿ, where ℝ^d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d). Assume ψ is C¹ at x₀ (ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ x₀, i.e. ψ is C¹ on some neighbourhood of x₀). Assume also that its derivative Dψ(x₀) = fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ is injective. Then there is a map g : ℝᴺ → ℝⁿ that is Fréchet differentiable at ψ(x₀) and satisfies g(ψ(x)) = x for every x in some neighbourhood of x₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (x₀ : Rn n), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ x₀ → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀) → ∃ g : Rn N → Rn n, DifferentiableAt ℝ g (ψ x₀) ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, g (ψ x) = x
